# HavenSpring LLC

> HavenSpring LLC is an adult residential care provider located in Ashwaubenon (Green Bay area), Brown County, Wisconsin. We provide compassionate 24/7 adult residential care, supportive living, personal care assistance, medication management, and respite services for adults needing structured daily support in a safe, warm, home-like environment.

## Organization Details
- **Legal Entity**: HavenSpring LLC
- **Facility Type**: Adult Residential Care Facility / Adult Family Home (AFH)
- **Address**: 469 Dutton Avenue, Ashwaubenon, WI 54304
- **Phone**: (414) 455-5899
- **Email**: havenspringllc@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://havenspringllc.com
- **Service Area**: Ashwaubenon, Green Bay, De Pere, Brown County, and surrounding Northeast Wisconsin communities
- **Operating Hours**: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year

## Core Services Offered
- **24-Hour Residential Supervision**: Awake, attentive staff providing continuous safety monitoring and immediate emergency response.
- **Personal Care Assistance**: Dignified, sensitive support with Activities of Daily Living (ADLs)—bathing, grooming, dressing, and mobility.
- **Medication Management & Assistance**: Secure, locked storage, prescription tracking, timely administration, and local pharmacy coordination.
- **Nutritious Meal Planning & Preparation**: Three freshly prepared, balanced daily meals and wholesome snacks tailored to individual dietary needs.
- **Health & Appointment Coordination**: Scheduling, clinical recordkeeping, and communication with local healthcare providers (Bellin Health, Aurora BayCare, St. Mary's, Prevea Health).
- **Companionship & Social Engagement**: Daily social activities, recreational pastimes, and a warm family-style living atmosphere.
- **Housekeeping & Laundry**: Daily environmental hygiene, room sanitization, fall prevention, and personal laundry care.
- **Transportation Coordination**: Accessible travel arrangements for medical visits, errands, and community events.
- **Community Integration**: Supported outings to local parks, cultural events, and community activities throughout Brown County.
- **Individualized Service Planning (ISP)**: Person-centered care plans developed collaboratively with residents, families, and case managers.
- **Respite Care**: Short-term residential stays providing relief for primary family caregivers.
